gloss: at that time, in those days

definitions.gloss: at that time, in those days
definitions.explanation: Refers to a specific period in the past that has been mentioned or is understood from context.

examples.japanese: {当時|とうじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
{当時|とうじ}、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: At that time, I was a student.

examples.japanese: {当時|とうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please show me photos from that time.

examples.japanese: {当時|とうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: In Japan at that time, the internet was not yet common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当時|とうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しそうに→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦くれました→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather happily told me about his memories from those days.

notes:
{当時|とうじ} refers to a specific period in the past that has already been mentioned or is understood from context. It always looks back to a defined time, not the general past.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {当時|とうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: ~ of that time ({当時|とうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧, {当時|とうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧)
- {当時|とうじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: at that time (topic marker)
- {当時|とうじ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since that time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧/⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧: at that time (conversational)
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧: in those days (nostalgic nuance)
- {当時|とうじ}: at that time (neutral to formal, often used in writing and narration)

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Common in written narratives, news articles, and historical accounts. In casual conversation, ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧ or ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧ is more natural.
